dimension_justifications.soundness: The formal conditional finite-pool definition and the displayed arithmetic are internally correct: the printed decompositions give +0.2227 and -0.0075. However, both central empirical records, the treatment, score construction, and decoder realization are explicitly unavailable, so the source-reported quantities cannot substantiate an empirical conclusion.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is concise, unusually explicit about SR/CV status, separates the natural-strata and paired records, and is anonymous and within the stated page limit. The organization makes its narrow evidentiary boundary easy to follow.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The strongest defensible output is a transparent cautionary accounting of two unavailable source records. Conditioning a descriptive mean difference on a finite pool and one stored realization is a useful clarification, but without accessible records, a reusable audit artifact, a general result, or a verified closest-work search, it is not a decision-relevant new ICLR contribution.

paper_summary: This four-page paper audits two source-reported GSM8K/LLaDA records: a natural-strata score-outcome difference of +0.2227 and a distinct 400-item paired +37-token fixed-filler record of -0.0075. It formalizes the latter as a finite-pool, recorded-single-decode descriptive estimand, verifies only printed arithmetic, and explicitly states that neither the underlying evidence nor broader causal, calibration, or decoder-average interpretations can be verified.
strongest_verified_contribution: A clear formal and evidentiary boundary: the paired -0.0075 is only a descriptive finite-pool contrast conditional on one asserted stored decode realization, and it cannot be compared inferentially with the separate natural-strata +0.2227 record.
strengths: Section 3 and Section 4.2 correctly prevent the common but invalid inference from juxtaposing the natural-strata and paired-filler point values.

The manuscript explicitly distinguishes independently checked definitions/arithmetic from source-reported empirical inputs (Table 1), rather than presenting unavailable results as reproduced evidence.
The arithmetic printed in Section 4 is consistent: -0.0314 - (-0.2541) = +0.2227 and -0.0799 - (-0.0724) = -0.0075.
Section 5 avoids claiming a new calibration metric or a general prompt-length effect, and identifies neighboring prompt-variation work with stated boundaries.
questions: Can the authors supply an immutable reviewer-accessible artifact bundle for A32-E1/A32-E2, including item identities, paired rows, literal prompts/filler, tokenizer-dose check, decode configuration/traces, score-to-event definition, and analysis reproducer?

What systematic search and closest-work matrix support novelty relative specifically to prompt-length/content-free-filler interventions and masked-diffusion uncertainty, beyond the three neighboring prompt-variation papers acknowledged in Section 5?

If the empirical artifacts remain unavailable, why should the paper be evaluated as an empirical ICLR contribution rather than a narrowly scoped methodological note that omits the uncheckable point estimates?

issues.location: PDF pp. 1-3, Sections 1-4; Table 1; Tables 2-3; evidence/experiment_registry.json (A32-X1, A32-X2) and evidence/repository_inventory.md
issues.observed_evidence: The included evidence records label both experiments source_reported_not_rerun and list missing item records, manifests, literal filler, prompt/decode traces, score construction, analysis code, and environment details. The manuscript correspondingly says all empirical numbers are SR/CV. Thus the point values and their claimed treatment/sample identities cannot be independently recomputed.
issues.why_it_matters: The paper's central object is an audit of a paired filler record, but the package cannot establish that the asserted filler intervention, paired pool, commit-score construct, final-answer labels, or recorded decode were actually instantiated as described. The formal conditional definition remains valid as notation, but it cannot validate or make scientifically informative the reported measurement.
issues.required_fix: Provide a frozen, reviewer-accessible reproduction bundle for both records and a stable evidence-ID-to-file crosswalk; otherwise remove the source-reported numerical findings and frame the work solely as a formal limitation note.
issues.verification_test: Rebuild Tables 2-3 from immutable per-item inputs with a supplied analysis script; verify the literal filler and insertion location tokenise to the stated dose, pairing/selection rules reproduce the pool, and trace-derived score and correctness definitions reproduce every reported arm mean and contrast.
issues.evidence_needed: Item manifests and rows, overlap map, literal serialized prompts/filler, tokenizer fixture, model/tokenizer revisions, decode configuration and traces, score/event specification, labels/matcher, analysis code, and deterministic or multi-realization replay records.

issues.location: PDF p. 3, Section 5, especially lines 151-166; citation_lock.json/citation_lock.json, remaining_unverified_scope
issues.observed_evidence: Section 5 positions the work against three neighboring prompt-variation studies and signed-summary references. The supplied citation lock itself states that a broader prompt-length-specific and masked-diffusion uncertainty search remains desirable; it supports only the limited neighboring-study boundaries.
issues.why_it_matters: The paper's asserted distinctiveness rests on the exact fixed-filler/masked-diffusion setting and its evidence-audit framing. A partial set of neighboring studies cannot establish that this positioning is novel or significant, especially when no verified empirical artifact is contributed. This is a cannot_verify limitation, not an allegation that a specific prior paper invalidates the claim.
issues.required_fix: Conduct and document a bounded, systematic closest-work search focused on prompt length, content-free filler/control interventions, confidence or score semantics, and masked/diffusion decoding; add a compact comparison matrix that distinguishes setting, estimand, available evidence, and contribution.
issues.verification_test: For every novelty/closest-work sentence, link the comparison-matrix row to a verified primary citation and check that the stated difference follows from the cited method and evaluation, without claiming identical contexts.
issues.evidence_needed: A reviewer-safe search protocol, inclusion/exclusion rationale, verified primary-source metadata/support notes, and a closest-work matrix covering the identified categories.

issues.location: PDF p. 1, Section 1 contribution list; PDF p. 2, Section 3; PDF p. 3, Sections 5 and 7
issues.observed_evidence: The listed contributions are a conditional finite-pool estimand, a distinction between arithmetic and empirical verification, and an inventory of missing artifacts. The manuscript offers no new experiment, theorem, reusable audit implementation, or verified dataset-level analysis, and expressly limits itself to an unavailable source-described record.
issues.why_it_matters: These clarifications are responsible and correctly scoped, but the current paper does not demonstrate a new capability or knowledge result beyond documenting why its own unverified source values cannot bear broader conclusions. This leaves the contribution identity too narrow for an ICLR research-paper acceptance.
issues.required_fix: Either supply the reproducible record bundle and use it to deliver a limited, falsifiable empirical result, or substantially strengthen the methodological contribution with a general audit framework, operational checks, and demonstrated application across independently accessible records.
issues.verification_test: An independent reviewer should be able to apply the released framework/reproducer to at least one complete record, recover the stated estimand and audit findings, and identify a conclusion that is not merely transcription of unavailable source values.
issues.evidence_needed: A reusable protocol and implementation plus complete accessible application data, or multiple fully auditable case studies showing that the framework yields decision-relevant findings.

ethics_concerns: No direct human-subject, privacy, or misuse concern is evidenced in the frozen package. The main responsible-research concern—overinterpreting unavailable empirical records—is candidly disclosed and is reflected in the issues above.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control, using only the frozen submission files and no external search or repository history.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A complete immutable reproduction bundle that independently regenerates both tables and validates the paired filler, sample, score, and decode provenance.
Deterministic replay or multiple paired decode realizations, together with a clearly scoped analysis of decoder-run variation.
A verified closest-work search and comparison matrix establishing a precise contribution boundary.
A demonstrated reusable audit method applied to complete accessible records, yielding a limited result beyond transcription.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Evidence that the asserted 400-item pool, +37-token intervention, pairing, or NFE=64 execution differs from the source description.
Trace-level evidence showing that the recorded commit score or final-answer correctness values cannot produce the reported summaries.
A verified closer prior work that already supplies the same estimand and evidence-audit contribution in the relevant setting.
review_limitations: I did not inspect the internet, prior rounds, author notes, repository history, or any files outside this frozen submission, as instructed.

The package explicitly withholds the empirical artifacts, so this review can verify only the formal definitions, printed arithmetic, supplied provenance statements, PDF format/anonymity, and the stated citation-lock scope; it cannot independently verify the source-reported measurements or literature completeness.
